name: Barbell Overhead Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a light barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your abs and glutes firmly while keeping a very slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep the bar smoothly forward and upward in a wide arc all the way overhead until your arms line up near your ears.
Lower the bar slowly back down along the same arc to your thighs.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down so your lower back does not arch as the bar passes overhead.
Use a light barbell and avoid leaning backward to swing the weight up.
